title: Vanguard of Darkness ＜Wave＞
text: The next day. We stood by waiting for the time of the Wave, I say. Everyone was checking over their own weapons, each lost in their own thoughts. Suddenly, a memory surfaced from the loop when I’d stayed in Melromarc. Back then, Sakura-chan, about the same height and build as Big Sister, had been at Father’s side, and Keel had been yipping and making a fuss. I’d been trying my best to trace the first world as faithfully as possible, but now here I was thinking about how to avoid making things turn out the same way… circumstances really do change, indeed. Even so, there was one thing that absolutely had to be done: protecting the Filolial-sama of Lute Village. The chimeras needed to be dealt with in a way that preserved as much of their bodies as possible. Under no circumstances should they be vaporized with Brionac, I say. After all, this was necessary for the equipment of Father, Ren, and Itsuki. Ren wanted the dragon’s head, so that part was fixed. As for the rest of the parts… which portion should Father use this time around? Well, that could be settled as things unfolded, no problem there.
Father approached a mixed-breed lizardman who stood gripping an axe, his expression grave.
“Shion, you okay?”
“……No problem. If anything, you’re the one who shouldn’t push it too hard. Don’t go trying to shield me.”
“Sorry, can’t promise that. Shielding people’s my job.”
Otherwise he’d just be a useless lump of wood—or worse, some kind of princess, Father muttered self-deprecatingly.
“It’s fine, everyone’s here, and our whole goal is guiding the evacuation anyway.”
“That’s right. Besides, there’s no enemy we could lose to as we are now. We’ve got Shion and Wolf with us!”
“Vow!”
The rabbit man and Wolf joined in, cheering Father and the others on.
The mixed-breed lizardman’s face softened into an awkward sort of smile.
“This time… I’ll see it through.”

Their bond seemed pretty solid, indeed. Incidentally, after some discussion, Older Sister had decided to participate in Waves happening in other countries. When Older Sister had taken part in the very first Wave… she’d performed like a one-woman army. During the evacuation, she’d mowed down every monster that swarmed in one after another, and her reliability stood head and shoulders above the rest of Father’s former slaves.
“Yuki and the others will help with the evacuation too!”
Yuki-chan had already spoken with the Filolial-sama of Lute Village beforehand. The evacuation was set to proceed swiftly.
“Kou’s gonna get the village kids to safety~ Hope Elemlo hurries up and gets here~”

Kou had learned all sorts of things from Elephant, and through interacting with Big Sister and the others, had grown up properly understanding that children were meant to be protected. Truly something to be proud of, I say. Compared to the world where Father had stayed in Melromarc, there was now no chance of Kou growing up traumatized and fearful. Back then, Kou had been… quite the little glutton, going on about whether Wave monsters tasted good.
“Wonder if Kuro can meet the Dark Swordsman~”
Kuro-chan was head over heels for Ren, as usual.
“Make sure to show off properly in the Wave and win Ren over, I say.”
“Yeah! Kuro and Dark Saint Hero’s fate ＜Black Destiny＞ will cross ＜Cross＞ in this dimension wave ＜Dimension Wave＞!”
Ohh, Kuro-chan was in especially high spirits. A little hard to follow, though.
“Can’t wait.”
“Yaaay!”
“Can we go wild?”

Of course, the other Filolial-sama were there too. But… Sakura-chan was not among them. ……Sakura-chan was Filo-tan. If I met Filo-tan, I couldn’t meet Sakura-chan. Thinking about that left me with a strangely frustrating feeling. Was it arrogant of me to wish for a moment when both of them could be together? Oh…? Perhaps it was a slip of memory, or my memories muddling together, but a vision spread through my mind of Sakura-chan and Filo-tan standing side by side. I do hope that comes true someday. Incidentally, behind me, Lazy Pig and Father were having an exchange. That pig apparently still wanted to slack off as always, and Father looked utterly exasperated.
“It’s almost time.”
The numbers on the hourglass reflected in my vision were creeping toward zero.
“Let’s do our best to keep casualties to a minimum. Everyone, no regrets, okay?”
“Waoooon!”
“Let’s do this!”
“Ah… I’ll protect them, absolutely, no matter what.”
“Let’s go, I say!”
“I’ll do my best!”
“““Waaah!”””
“And so begins the legend of the Dark Swordsman and the Jet-Black Claws and Fangs!”
Father turned to face me.
“All right, Motoyasu-kun.”
“A rousing send-off, indeed. Everyone here has trained hard and grown strong for this very day. That effort will absolutely bear fruit. Let us show the world the full extent of our power!”
With my battle cry, the number hit zero, and the very first Wave of this loop began. It really had been a while, indeed, since I’d faced a Wave at this particular point in time.
“This is… right. Everyone! Let’s go!”

Father checked our surroundings and gave the order. It would’ve been quite the shock if the Wave had struck somewhere else entirely, I say. Given that it involved the Spirit of the Spear, it seemed all too plausible that some kind of power could be used to tamper with the location—a frightening thought, indeed. After all, the Crimson Swine’s true body wasn’t even present, and with the current goal being simply to keep the loop going… that pig would probably mess around with even those kinds of settings. Isn’t it entirely possible it actually could pull that off? That’s about how much I suspect that pig these days. I will absolutely turn it into an axle, mark my words. Drive Mode, vroom vroom, I say. Haven’t done that much lately, though.
“Eh? Hey!”
“They really are charging straight ahead. Well, as far as strategy goes, having the attackers head there first probably isn’t a bad idea.”
The rabbit man shaded his eyes with one hand, watching Ren, Itsuki, and their companions sprint headlong toward the Wave’s rift.
“Ah, found the Dark Saint Hero~ Kuro’s coming too~”
Poof! Kuro-chan transformed into her Filolial-sama form and ran alongside Ren.
“Dark Saint Hero~ Kuro’s coming with you~”
“Hm!? This one is… that line!?”
Ren stopped running and turned to face us.
“This isn’t playtime! Get back there right now!”
“Ehh, Kuro won’t lose~ The Jet-Black Claws and Fangs is gonna send this Vanguard of Darkness back into the dark, together with the Dark Saint Hero~”
Just as Kuro-chan finished answering, a Dimensional Ghoul lunged to attack. But before Ren could even react in time, Kuro-chan kicked it away and landed smoothly.
“Shakiin!”
“Wh, whoa……”
“We’re heading over there, right~ Dark Saint Hero~ Let’s go~”
“Wa! Hey! What are you—”
Kuro-chan grabbed Ren by the collar, forcibly hauled him onto her back, and took off running.
“Ren-sama!”
“Ren-san!?”
Kuro-chan went trotting merrily along, overtaking Itsuki’s group entirely.
“Put me dooown!”
“Hyah!”

And so, with Ren riding on her back, Kuro-chan sent the swarming Wave monsters flying left and right. At first Ren had been shouting to be let down, but apparently impressed by Kuro-chan’s moves, he ended up staying put, swinging his sword from her back all the while.
“Haaah!”
“We can’t let Ren-san outdo us! Let’s go!”
And Itsuki, for his part, seemed determined to head over too, not wanting to fall behind.
“Ah… well, since Kuro-chan headed off with Ren, let’s prioritize the evacuation guidance.”
“Of course, I say! The Filolial-sama come first!”
“Everyone, follow Yuki and let’s help the Filolials and the people!”
“““Yes, ma’am!”””

Yuki-chan, the Filolial-sama, and I rushed straight to the Filolial ranch in Lute Village, smashing through the fences and taking down the monsters swarming in. With this formation, we would protect the Filolial-sama completely, I say!
“I mean… that guy really doesn’t waver at all, does he.”
“True. He prioritizes Filolials over people.”
“Well… that’s Motoyasu-kun for you.”
“Vow, vow!”

Meanwhile, Father and the others focused on guiding the evacuation while keeping an eye on all this. But Wolf, apparently worked up, was snorting hard and turning his attention toward the approaching monsters, ready to attack.
“Whoa, Wolf! No, don’t… you’re too worked up.”
Father moved closer, apparently trying to hold Wolf back.
“Vow, vo… uu… kyuun.”
“Ah, yeah, yeah. Telling Wolf to calm down when… given the mood, that’s probably a tall order.”
“Buhiiiiii!”
At the shriek of one of the village’s pigs, the mixed-breed lizardman raised his axe and cut down the approaching monster to defend her.
